dev_slice.slice: decision rows [0, 40): first 40 decision grid points + full warmup history (all candles with close_time <= first slice signal_time). SMALL by design. Insufficient history is WARMUP, never a strategy WAIT
dev_slice.warmup_rule: explicit per W1 manifest; adapter must refuse (WARMUP status) when history is short, never emit a silent WAIT

execution_core.guard: dd_guard sizing (trigger 0.1, guard lev 0.5, full lev 1.0, max 1.0) reading ONLY the separate iso4_only_1x control book exits strictly before T (1us cutoff); paper-account-equity guard is REJECTED (known r75 limitation)
execution_core.leverage: fixed 1x baseline (ExecutionConfig leverage 1.0, max_leverage 1.0; guard column clamped into [0.25, 1.0] per v159 convention)

execution_core.signal_fill_rule: signal at t fills no earlier than t+1; entry-bar TP suppression on

no_replay_inputs.audit_method: TWO legs, both recorded in summary.json: (a) static source scan of the W1/W2 streaming path for forbidden loads (predictions.npz, signals.parquet, stored decisions/ATR snapshots, control exit/trade CSVs, decision_indices); (b) runtime denial test: remove/deny those files and still obtain actual predictions with checkpoint-called proof (forward-pass timing/call counter in W2 provenance). Either leg failing = FAIL
forbidden_in_streaming_path: stored control exit/trade CSVs (control exits recomputed live past-only)
decision_indices / bar-index matching against stored signals in fresh mode
no_replay_inputs.reference_loaded_only_by_harness: reference artifacts (batch signals, control book) may be loaded ONLY by scripts/opencode_r76_parity.py comparison harness, never by the streaming path

pass_rules.portfolio_match: per-branch final equity AND per-trade equity_after within 1e-6 absolute (normal + fee .00055); report gross PnL, fees, funding, net PnL, drawdown, trade count, coverage per AGENTS.md rule 6
pass_rules.prefix_future_perturbation: truncate-to-prefix rerun must reproduce the prefix exactly; future perturbation must rebuild features + rerun the model (proven by W2 provenance inference-call log), never reuse stored outputs
pass_rules.restart: kill/resume mid-slice with partial positions + pending entries must yield identical fills + equity (exactly-once, snapshot fingerprint)
pass_rules.signal_set_identity: streaming vs batch signal sets bit-identical on (bar_index, signal_time, direction, entry_limit, stop_loss, take_profit_1, take_profit_2, holding_bars, leverage, entry_expiry_bars, tp1_fraction); numerics exact, no tolerance
pass_rules.wait_behavior: slice must capture >=1 non-WAIT historical case; WAIT rows must yield no signal WITHOUT forcing a fresh market signal

poll_budget.then: return PREP-READY, do NOT block forever
